tool_args.rationale: The observations show a saturating response to u_now and a decreasing response to s_grad. The code numerically fits three compact smooth transfer models and selects among them by leave-one-out error. All paid rows have the same horizon and other state variables, so their effects remain unidentified; fresh confirmation is needed to test the selected model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid branch observations show a substantial gradient effect, which this model cannot represent.
The pilot response saturates strongly with increasing u_now rather than increasing linearly.
The listed informative probes have already been acquired; the available data now support testing gradient-dependent saturation on fresh confirmation.
